scope: For every prime q>5, N=5q, binary R, and D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta_N**(r*c), no D*D=dI or DD*=dI exists at integer 2q<d<3q.
review_verdict_projection: Only candidate_directory removed; every scientific value retained. Original verdict hash is pinned by the exact original review manifest and source ledger.
source_acceptance: Independent final review of the exact frozen candidate passed without repair. Candidate pending-review labels are retained historical text and are superseded only by this bound final acceptance.
source_manifest_checks: All 20 candidate and 26 review original manifest entries, plus both manifests and seals, verified locally before export. This does not claim that omitted original entries exist or verify in the public export.
